name: Pipeliners - Website Pages Tracker
body:
> Tracker · Pipeliners · 2026-10-13

# Summary
Build folder for the "Pipeliners Website Pages" tracker artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/UHmTcm1feD5CdnMKSHPQq1). The tracker lists every live page with type, Google index status, clicks, impressions, word count, FAQ presence, last update, ad-protected flag, status and notes. The artifact saves Kim's edits into itself, so the live version is re-read before every republish.

# Key facts
- `pages.json` holds 116 page records: 57 Blog, 37 Local, 11 Core, 5 Service, 4 Service guide, 2 Ad page.
- Fields per page: id, name, path, type, google, clicks, shown, words, faq, updated, protected, status, note, draft, published, impr.
- An "Impressions (GSC)" column was added to every tab on Sep 29, and a "Leads by source" tab carries the monthly Keystone CRM pull (next Oct 29 per the handoff).
- `template.html` is the page template (v9 and v10 backups kept); `website-pages-2026-10-13.html` is the latest rendered build.
- Supporting data: `gsc_top_queries.json`, `live_crawl.json` (and a Sep 16 crawl), `pub_dates.json`, `wp_changed.tsv` (WordPress modified dates per post).

# Versions and backups
Dated `pages.backup-*.json` and `pipeliners-website-pages.backup-*.html` files from Sep 16 to Oct 2 record the state before each refresh (pre-merge notes, quick wins, indexing, blog keyword alignment, audit, local, core, services and keyword checks). They are history only.
